cards.t: THORChain resumes swaps following hack fund laundering
cards.b: THORChain has restored trading on Bitcoin, Ethereum, and several other networks following a refund bug, while stolen funds from the Binance hack continue to be routed through it.

per.RUNE: Rallied as THORChain restarted most swaps after a halt.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Timeline for fully restoring the remaining paused chains.

cards.t: Canton Coin viewed as digital commodity by SEC staff
cards.b: SEC staff issued a no-action letter stating they view Canton Coin as a digital commodity and will not recommend enforcement over its programmatic issuance.

per.CC: Received an SEC staff no-action letter classifying it as a digital commodity.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Binding legal status beyond SEC staff no-action view.

cards.t: Coinbase adds CARDS to listing roadmap
cards.b: Collector Crypt's CARDS token has been added to the Coinbase listing roadmap, prompting a price increase.

per.CARDS: Added to the Coinbase listing roadmap.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST

cards.t: NEAR governance approves token issuance cut
cards.b: NEAR's House of Stake passed a proposal to lower the network's maximum annual issuance rate from 2.5% to 1.6% over 24 months, preventing millions of NEAR from entering circulation.

per.NEAR: Governance approved a reduction in the annual issuance ceiling.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact schedule of the phased issuance reduction.

cards.t: Moscow Exchange to launch Bitcoin and USDT trading in December
cards.b: Russia's main bourse, the Moscow Exchange, plans to launch Bitcoin, Ether, and USDT trading on December 1 under a new law with annual purchase limits.

per.BTC: Scheduled for trading launch on the Moscow Exchange.
per.USDT: Scheduled for trading launch on the Moscow Exchange.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
cards.missing: Specific details on volume limits and implementation mechanics.

cards.t: Binance misses monthly Luna Classic burn
cards.b: Binance has missed its monthly Luna Classic burn for the first time since 2023 as the exchange recovers from a major security breach.

per.LUNC: Did not receive its expected monthly burn from Binance.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: When Binance will resume the LUNC token burns.
